descriptionChirho: Gold, the precious metal; an Aramaic noun (dehab) used extensively in Daniel and Ezra for golden vessels, statues, and ornamentation (Dan 2:32, 3:1, 5:2; Ezra 5:14, 6:5). English 'gold/and gold', Spanish 'oro/y el oro', Hindi सोने/और सोना, Arabic ذَهَبٍ/وَ ذَهَب, Korean 금/그리고 금, Swahili 'dhahabu/na dhahabu'. The conjunctive prefix waw does not alter the lexical meaning of the noun.
